Exact signed 3-cycle and mod3/mod5 quotient cochains yield action +1 on H3 for every element; 48 signed Lefschetz sums equal sign*fixed-block formula for H2. Character equality implies rational module isomorphism, with no unverified infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The unique Möbius–Kantor (8_3) incidence geometry supplies a canonical full 48-element symmetry group and four natural exceptional point pairs. Determining the full sign-twisted permutation representation of H2, its 1+3 decomposition, and contrasting fixed subspaces H2=0/H3=1 resolves symmetry data not fixed by previously known sphere multiplicities or a cyclic-subgroup character. It is a natural complete symmetry invariant, not a deliberately chosen unmotivated parameter slice.
